kurz: Work fat into a watery ingredient so slowly and vigorously that it breaks into tiny droplets and stays bound.
bild_im_kopf: Like letting guests into a hall one at a time instead of all at once: everyone finds their place, nobody pushes.
was_passiert: At the start there is little water to take up fat. That is why the first fat has to go in drop by drop. Once the [[emulsion|emulsion]] has formed, it takes up fat faster. The [[emulgator|emulsifier]] needs time and movement to coat each new droplet.
schritte: Stir egg yolk or mustard with a little acid and salt.
Add the oil drop by drop at first, whisking hard.
Once the mixture thickens, add oil in a thin stream.
Too thick? Stir in a few drops of water or lemon juice.
If it splits, start again in a new bowl with a fresh yolk and slowly work in the split mixture.
